content.short: Hashport enables fast and secure cross-network transfer of digital assets.
content.description: Hashport is an enterprise-grade public utility that enables the movement of digital assets across distributed networks, expanding their reach quickly, securely, and cost-effectively. To remain platform-neutral, Hashport operates without a proprietary token. The network rests on a robust, high-performance architecture and is secured and operated by leading validator partners worldwide. Hashport has undergone a rigorous security audit and adheres to industry best practices, with regular network tests to ensure integrity. It currently bridges crypto assets between Hedera, Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, and Optimism.
